iteration4_hindi_stt.problem: multilingual Whisper-tiny on real Hindi (FLEURS hi_in test, 100 sentences): CER 1.04 / WER 1.05 — translation, loops, garble
iteration4_hindi_stt.candidates_searched: Hugging Face Hub Hindi/Hinglish Whisper fine-tunes; on-device-sized ones exported with Optimum and decoded with the app's decoder (speech_lab/eval_hindi_asr.py)
iteration4_hindi_stt.first_screen_notes: first screen (same 100 FLEURS + 33 command samples, scored with the pre-upgrade romaniser); collabora models never emit end-of-text under the app's KV greedy decoder
iteration4_hindi_stt.decision: ship ARTPARK-IISc/whisper-tiny-vaani-hindi (Apache-2.0) as the Hindi specialist: fp16-stored encoder (16.5 MB, fp32 compute; INT8 doubled FLEURS CER) + INT8 decoders with one shared token table (30.4 + 29.2 MB); all graphs pass check_ort_compat.py under onnxruntime 1.18.0
iteration4_hindi_stt.routing: multilingual tiny encoder + step-0 LID; LID 'hi' -> the same Mel re-encoded and decoded (<|hi|>) by the specialist; manual Hinglish mode skips the multilingual pass

lid.regression: an English sentence misrouted to Hindi is now transliterated into Devanagari by the specialist (held-out EN display CER 0.06 -> 0.36, driven by 'Wake me up at 6:30 AM tomorrow.' at P(hi) 0.77-0.98); the English/Hinglish chips force a path

rejected_logprob_arbitration.idea: for uncertain LID decode with both models and keep the higher mean token log-prob
rejected_logprob_arbitration.result: no routing change: the specialist is confident even on English audio

iteration4_hindi_stt.romaniser: Devanagari -> Roman: curated lexicon + reversed Hinglish lexicon (gold), number words -> digits before units, PM/AM letters, fused-word split, G2P (IndicPhonemizer) romaniser with Hinglish endings for unseen words
